info.name: Rackspace Cloud DNS Contacts Domains API

description.content:
The Rackspace Cloud DNS API (v1.0) provides programmatic management of DNS zones and records hosted on the Rackspace Cloud. Operations include listing, creating, updating, importing, exporting, and cloning domains, plus full CRUD on standard DNS records and reverse DNS PTR records, with support for paginated listings, asynchronous job tracking, and per-account usage limits.
